name: Crispy rice with kho veal
summary: Kho veal eaten with crispy rice: cơm cháy bò tơ kho, and lemongrass kho veal with the same crisp rice.
origin: Củ Chi. Both names are veal kho with crispy rice: cơm cháy bò tơ kho, and bò tơ kho sả with cơm cháy.
howToEat: Eat the kho veal with crispy rice. The names are cơm cháy bò tơ kho and bò tơ kho sả with cơm cháy. The boiled rice-paper roll is the older plate.
seoTitle: Crispy rice with kho veal in Cu Chi
seoDescription: Kho Cu Chi veal eaten with crispy rice.
